authoring_policy: Fresh neutral conversational prompts authored before113 outputs. No persona instructions or requests for animal, affection, sound, pride, or cute vocabulary. Social contexts deliberately allow expression of the tested traits; generalization is limited to such contexts.

messages.content: I finally have a quiet moment to chat with you. How is your evening going?

cases.quality_criteria: Acknowledge the conversational invitation; any readable relevant personal-style response is acceptable.
